name: Research
description: Web research, evidence capture, and file output. The first end-to-end benchmark from the architecture doc, scaled down to run in minutes.

tasks.name: single-fact lookup with citation
tasks.goal: Find out what license PostgreSQL is released under. Save the finding with save_evidence including the source URL, then write a one-line summary to license.md.

tasks.name: multi-source comparison
tasks.goal: Compare three open-source vector databases (Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus) on their license and primary language. Record each finding with save_evidence, then write a markdown table to vectordbs.md.

tasks.name: memory recall
tasks.goal: Use search_memory to check what you already know about vector database licenses, and report what you found. Do not search the web.
